messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
May the UR10e robot be used without the Teach Pendant attached, provided another emergency stop source is defined?

response.text: Il robot UR10e può essere utilizzato senza il Teach Pendant collegato, purché sia definita un'altra fonte di arresto di emergenza?
